title: 隧道超前探測鑽孔
titleEn: Probe drilling ahead of tunnel faces
summary: 本課聚焦以孔位、鑽進訊號與水文證據建立可更新的掌子面前方模型。沿著調查依據、物理作用、數量估算、現場驗證到工程交接逐項建立可追溯的推論鏈，特別辨別單一數值無法揭露的空間差異及時間效應。以獨立量測檢驗簡化模型，並把觀測結果、教學假設與需要主管工程師審查的決策清楚分列。
summaryEn: This course focuses on build an updateable ahead-of-face model from borehole geometry, drilling signals and hydraulic evidence. It develops a traceable reasoning chain from evidence and physical processes through quantitative estimates, field verification and engineering handover. Spatial variation and time effects are separated from a single nominal result. Independent observations test the simplified models, while measured evidence, teaching assumptions and decisions requiring the responsible engineer remain explicitly distinguished.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 地層條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.titleEn: Ground conditions, boundaries and engineering system
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「探測目標與盲區」與「孔跡與角度誤差」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Targets and blind zones" and "Trajectory and angular error": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 探測目標與盲區：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Targets and blind zones: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「探測目標與盲區」如何影響隧道超前探測鑽孔的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Targets and blind zones” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Probe drilling ahead of tunnel faces”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 超前鑽孔是一條細長的取樣路徑，孔間未穿越的岩體仍可能藏有斷層。先把要回答的問題分成岩性界面、含水帶與空洞，再檢查孔軸是否真正截交目標；孔深不能代替橫向覆蓋。 假設孔長30 m、偏角10°，橫向距離為30 sin10°=5.21 m；小角度定位誤差仍須另列。 若將兩個無異常孔之間直接填成完整岩體，偏斜斷層可能被漏掉；開挖後突然出現破碎帶，原先支護與水處理預案便失去依據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「探測目標與盲區」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A probe hole samples a slender path through the ground. A fault can remain between adjacent paths even when both holes are long. Separate the questions of lithological boundaries, water-bearing zones and voids, then check whether the planned trajectories actually intersect each target. For an assumed 30 m hole inclined by 10°, lateral reach is 30 sin10°=5.21 m; small angular positioning errors require separate allowance. Interpolating intact rock between two uneventful holes can miss an oblique fault. Unexpected broken ground during excavation then undermines the original support and water-management assumptions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Targets and blind zones” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鑽得越深就一定已排除整個掌子面前方風險。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Greater drilling depth always eliminates risk across the entire face ahead." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「探測目標與盲區」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Targets and blind zones”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 探測目標與盲區
knowledge.text: 超前鑽孔是一條細長的取樣路徑，孔間未穿越的岩體仍可能藏有斷層。先把要回答的問題分成岩性界面、含水帶與空洞，再檢查孔軸是否真正截交目標；孔深不能代替橫向覆蓋。
knowledge.textEn: A probe hole samples a slender path through the ground. A fault can remain between adjacent paths even when both holes are long.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：鑽得越深就一定已排除整個掌子面前方風險。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Greater drilling depth always eliminates risk across the entire face ahead. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「隧道超前探測鑽孔」的「探測目標與盲區：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出地層、地下水、開挖邊界與支撐的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「地下水與沉陷觀測室」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與地質假設、監測位置、時間順序及基準點版本的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Targets and blind zones: mechanism and system paths” in “Probe drilling ahead of tunnel faces”. Draw the ground, groundwater, excavation boundary and support interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Groundwater and settlement observatory” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for ground assumptions, monitoring locations, time order and benchmark version, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「探測目標與盲區」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Targets and blind zones" is correct?
options: 鑽得越深就一定已排除整個掌子面前方風險。
超前鑽孔是一條細長的取樣路徑，孔間未穿越的岩體仍可能藏有斷層。
孔口方向正確即可把所有孔內位置當成直線。
optionsEn: Greater drilling depth always eliminates risk across the entire face ahead.
A probe hole samples a slender path through the ground.
A correct collar direction makes every downhole position a straight-line projection.
quiz.explanation: 超前鑽孔是一條細長的取樣路徑，孔間未穿越的岩體仍可能藏有斷層。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A probe hole samples a slender path through the ground. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 探測目標與盲區：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Targets and blind zones: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「探測目標與盲區」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Targets and blind zones” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設孔長30 m、偏角10°，橫向距離為30 sin10°=5.21 m；小角度定位誤差仍須另列。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed 30 m hole inclined by 10°, lateral reach is 30 sin10°=5.21 m; small angular positioning errors require separate allowance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將孔口座標與實測方位投到同一里程剖面，標出各孔的覆蓋範圍及無資料區。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot surveyed collars and measured bearings on one chainage section, explicitly marking unsampled zones.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設孔長30 m、偏角10°，橫向距離為30 sin10°=5.21 m；小角度定位誤差仍須另列。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. For an assumed 30 m hole inclined by 10°, lateral reach is 30 sin10°=5.21 m; small angular positioning errors require separate allowance.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「探測目標與盲區」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Targets and blind zones", which statement holds?
options: 岩屑從孔口流出時的鑽頭深度就是它的原始深度。
兩孔表壓相同就代表它們具有相同的地下水水頭。
以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
optionsEn: Bit depth when cuttings emerge is their original geological depth.
Equal gauge pressures in two holes imply equal groundwater head.
The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 探測目標與盲區：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Targets and blind zones: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「探測目標與盲區」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Targets and blind zones” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將孔口座標與實測方位投到同一里程剖面，標出各孔的覆蓋範圍及無資料區。以已知出露面或追加交叉孔驗證目標是否截交；地質師須逐項確認原先問題已回答，不能以完成鑽孔數量代替調查品質。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot surveyed collars and measured bearings on one chainage section, explicitly marking unsampled zones. Compare target intersections with mapped exposures or independent crossing holes. The geologist must confirm which original questions have been answered; completing the planned number of holes is not itself an acceptance criterion. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：調查圖必須同時顯示孔跡與未取樣體積，將不能排除的地質假說交由主管地質工程師決定追加調查或保留控制措施。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Show both trajectories and unsampled volumes on the investigation drawing, and refer unresolved geological hypotheses to the responsible geotechnical engineer for additional evidence or retained controls.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若將兩個無異常孔之間直接填成完整岩體，偏斜斷層可能被漏掉；開挖後突然出現破碎帶，原先支護與水處理預案便失去依據。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Interpolating intact rock between two uneventful holes can miss an oblique fault. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將孔口座標與實測方位投到同一里程剖面，標出各孔的覆蓋範圍及無資料區。以已知出露面或追加交叉孔驗證目標是否截交；地質師須逐項確認原先問題已回答，不能以完成鑽孔數量代替調查品質。
knowledge.textEn: Plot surveyed collars and measured bearings on one chainage section, explicitly marking unsampled zones. Compare target intersections with mapped exposures or independent crossing holes. The geologist must confirm which original questions have been answered; completing the planned number of holes is not itself an acceptance criterion.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 調查圖必須同時顯示孔跡與未取樣體積，將不能排除的地質假說交由主管地質工程師決定追加調查或保留控制措施。
knowledge.textEn: Show both trajectories and unsampled volumes on the investigation drawing, and refer unresolved geological hypotheses to the responsible geotechnical engineer for additional evidence or retained controls.

quiz.question: 要驗證「探測目標與盲區」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Targets and blind zones"?
options: 將孔口座標與實測方位投到同一里程剖面，標出各孔的覆蓋範圍及無資料區。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、開挖序列與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
兩種儀器都沒有警報就代表風險機率必定為零。
optionsEn: Plot surveyed collars and measured bearings on one chainage section, explicitly marking unsampled zones.
Temperature, water head, excavation sequence and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
No alarm from two instruments necessarily means zero hazard probability.
quiz.explanation: 將孔口座標與實測方位投到同一里程剖面，標出各孔的覆蓋範圍及無資料區。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Plot surveyed collars and measured bearings on one chainage section, explicitly marking unsampled zones. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 探測目標與盲區：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Targets and blind zones: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「探測目標與盲區」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Targets and blind zones” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若將兩個無異常孔之間直接填成完整岩體，偏斜斷層可能被漏掉；開挖後突然出現破碎帶，原先支護與水處理預案便失去依據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Interpolating intact rock between two uneventful holes can miss an oblique fault. Unexpected broken ground during excavation then undermines the original support and water-management assumptions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若將兩個無異常孔之間直接填成完整岩體，偏斜斷層可能被漏掉；開挖後突然出現破碎帶，原先支護與水處理預案便失去依據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Unexpected broken ground during excavation then undermines the original support and water-management assumptions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「鑽得越深就一定已排除整個掌子面前方風險。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Greater drilling depth always eliminates risk across the entire face ahead." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若將兩個無異常孔之間直接填成完整岩體，偏斜斷層可能被漏掉；開挖後突然出現破碎帶，原先支護與水處理預案便失去依據。
knowledge.textEn: Interpolating intact rock between two uneventful holes can miss an oblique fault. Unexpected broken ground during excavation then undermines the original support and water-management assumptions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「探測目標與盲區」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Targets and blind zones" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若將兩個無異常孔之間直接填成完整岩體，偏斜斷層可能被漏掉；開挖後突然出現破碎帶，原先支護與水處理預案便失去依據。
孔口方向正確即可把所有孔內位置當成直線。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Interpolating intact rock between two uneventful holes can miss an oblique fault.
A correct collar direction makes every downhole position a straight-line projection.
quiz.explanation: 若將兩個無異常孔之間直接填成完整岩體，偏斜斷層可能被漏掉；開挖後突然出現破碎帶，原先支護與水處理預案便失去依據。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Interpolating intact rock between two uneventful holes can miss an oblique fault. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 孔跡與角度誤差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Trajectory and angular error: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「孔跡與角度誤差」如何影響隧道超前探測鑽孔的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Trajectory and angular error” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Probe drilling ahead of tunnel faces”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 孔軸會因層面、鑽具剛度與鑽進偏心而彎曲，孔口方向只是起點。長孔把很小的角度偏差放大成可觀的平面位置差，因此地層交界里程必須附帶孔跡品質，不能只用鑽桿長度定位。 假設直孔100 m有1°方位偏差，末端側向差100 sin1°=1.745 m；這不是隨機誤差的標準差。 若鋼製設備使磁方位偏轉而未被識別，孔跡可能看似平順卻整體錯位；不同孔的同一地層因此被誤判為錯動或厚度變化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「孔跡與角度誤差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Boreholes curve under bedding effects, drill-string stiffness and eccentric drilling. Collar orientation describes only the starting direction. A small angular bias produces a substantial positional difference over a long hole, so an interpreted contact needs trajectory quality as well as rod length. An assumed straight 100 m hole with a 1° bearing bias has a lateral offset of 100 sin1°=1.745 m; this is not a random-error standard deviation. Unrecognized magnetic interference from steel equipment can shift an apparently smooth trajectory. The same geological contact in different holes may then be mistaken for fault displacement or changing thickness. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Trajectory and angular error” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「孔口方向正確即可把所有孔內位置當成直線。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A correct collar direction makes every downhole position a straight-line projection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「孔跡與角度誤差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Trajectory and angular error”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 孔跡與角度誤差
knowledge.text: 孔軸會因層面、鑽具剛度與鑽進偏心而彎曲，孔口方向只是起點。長孔把很小的角度偏差放大成可觀的平面位置差，因此地層交界里程必須附帶孔跡品質，不能只用鑽桿長度定位。
knowledge.textEn: Boreholes curve under bedding effects, drill-string stiffness and eccentric drilling. Collar orientation describes only the starting direction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：孔口方向正確即可把所有孔內位置當成直線。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A correct collar direction makes every downhole position a straight-line projection. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「孔跡與角度誤差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Trajectory and angular error" is correct?
options: 孔口方向正確即可把所有孔內位置當成直線。
比能越大就能直接換算出越高的岩石抗壓強度。
孔軸會因層面、鑽具剛度與鑽進偏心而彎曲，孔口方向只是起點。
optionsEn: A correct collar direction makes every downhole position a straight-line projection.
Higher specific energy directly determines a higher uniaxial rock strength.
Boreholes curve under bedding effects, drill-string stiffness and eccentric drilling.
quiz.explanation: 孔軸會因層面、鑽具剛度與鑽進偏心而彎曲，孔口方向只是起點。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Boreholes curve under bedding effects, drill-string stiffness and eccentric drilling. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 孔跡與角度誤差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Trajectory and angular error: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「孔跡與角度誤差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Trajectory and angular error” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設直孔100 m有1°方位偏差，末端側向差100 sin1°=1.745 m；這不是隨機誤差的標準差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed straight 100 m hole with a 1° bearing bias has a lateral offset of 100 sin1°=1.745 m; this is not a random-error standard deviation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：使用適合現場磁性環境的孔內測斜方法，與孔口獨立測量連接並保留測站間距。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use a deviation survey suited to the magnetic environment and connect it to an independent collar survey.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。假設直孔100 m有1°方位偏差，末端側向差100 sin1°=1.745 m；這不是隨機誤差的標準差。
knowledge.textEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. An assumed straight 100 m hole with a 1° bearing bias has a lateral offset of 100 sin1°=1.745 m; this is not a random-error standard deviation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「孔跡與角度誤差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Trajectory and angular error", which statement holds?
options: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。
返水比供水多就足以推算整座隧道的湧水量。
單孔得到的滲透係數可無條件套用到整個隧道長度。
optionsEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings.
Excess return flow is sufficient to predict total tunnel groundwater inflow.
A permeability from one borehole applies unconditionally along the entire tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 以下為教學假設，非現場操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: The following are teaching assumptions, not field operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 孔跡與角度誤差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Trajectory and angular error: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「孔跡與角度誤差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Trajectory and angular error” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 使用適合現場磁性環境的孔內測斜方法，與孔口獨立測量連接並保留測站間距。把正反向讀值和已知控制段比較，釐清系統偏差；地層位置的允收精度須由調查目的訂定，不能只引用儀器型錄精度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use a deviation survey suited to the magnetic environment and connect it to an independent collar survey. Retain station spacing and compare reverse readings with a known control interval. Specify acceptable contact-location uncertainty from the investigation purpose rather than the instrument brochure alone. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接孔跡時提供原始角度、坐標基準、修正方法及誤差範圍，讓設計者重建地層位置；大於目的精度的偏差由測量主管核准處置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Deliver raw angles, coordinate datum, correction method and uncertainty so the designer can reconstruct contacts; the survey lead must resolve deviations exceeding the purpose-specific positional requirement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若鋼製設備使磁方位偏轉而未被識別，孔跡可能看似平順卻整體錯位；不同孔的同一地層因此被誤判為錯動或厚度變化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unrecognized magnetic interference from steel equipment can shift an apparently smooth trajectory. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 使用適合現場磁性環境的孔內測斜方法，與孔口獨立測量連接並保留測站間距。把正反向讀值和已知控制段比較，釐清系統偏差；地層位置的允收精度須由調查目的訂定，不能只引用儀器型錄精度。
knowledge.textEn: Use a deviation survey suited to the magnetic environment and connect it to an independent collar survey. Retain station spacing and compare reverse readings with a known control interval. Specify acceptable contact-location uncertainty from the investigation purpose rather than the instrument brochure alone.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接孔跡時提供原始角度、坐標基準、修正方法及誤差範圍，讓設計者重建地層位置；大於目的精度的偏差由測量主管核准處置。
knowledge.textEn: Deliver raw angles, coordinate datum, correction method and uncertainty so the designer can reconstruct contacts; the survey lead must resolve deviations exceeding the purpose-specific positional requirement.

quiz.question: 要驗證「孔跡與角度誤差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Trajectory and angular error"?
options: 沿用另一條隧道或另一處地層的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
使用適合現場磁性環境的孔內測斜方法，與孔口獨立測量連接並保留測站間距。
回收率高就能證明岩體沒有節理或軟弱夾層。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another tunnel or ground formation counts as verifying this structure.
Use a deviation survey suited to the magnetic environment and connect it to an independent collar survey.
High core recovery proves that the rock mass has no joints or weak interbeds.
quiz.explanation: 使用適合現場磁性環境的孔內測斜方法，與孔口獨立測量連接並保留測站間距。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use a deviation survey suited to the magnetic environment and connect it to an independent collar survey. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 孔跡與角度誤差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Trajectory and angular error: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「孔跡與角度誤差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Trajectory and angular error” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若鋼製設備使磁方位偏轉而未被識別，孔跡可能看似平順卻整體錯位；不同孔的同一地層因此被誤判為錯動或厚度變化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unrecognized magnetic interference from steel equipment can shift an apparently smooth trajectory. The same geological contact in different holes may then be mistaken for fault displacement or changing thickness. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若鋼製設備使磁方位偏轉而未被識別，孔跡可能看似平順卻整體錯位；不同孔的同一地層因此被誤判為錯動或厚度變化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The same geological contact in different holes may then be mistaken for fault displacement or changing thickness.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「孔口方向正確即可把所有孔內位置當成直線。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A correct collar direction makes every downhole position a straight-line projection." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若鋼製設備使磁方位偏轉而未被識別，孔跡可能看似平順卻整體錯位；不同孔的同一地層因此被誤判為錯動或厚度變化。
knowledge.textEn: Unrecognized magnetic interference from steel equipment can shift an apparently smooth trajectory. The same geological contact in different holes may then be mistaken for fault displacement or changing thickness.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「孔跡與角度誤差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Trajectory and angular error" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
比能越大就能直接換算出越高的岩石抗壓強度。
若鋼製設備使磁方位偏轉而未被識別，孔跡可能看似平順卻整體錯位；不同孔的同一地層因此被誤判為錯動或厚度變化。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Higher specific energy directly determines a higher uniaxial rock strength.
Unrecognized magnetic interference from steel equipment can shift an apparently smooth trajectory.
quiz.explanation: 若鋼製設備使磁方位偏轉而未被識別，孔跡可能看似平順卻整體錯位；不同孔的同一地層因此被誤判為錯動或厚度變化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unrecognized magnetic interference from steel equipment can shift an apparently smooth trajectory. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
